content: आर्तव {%a.%} (-वा, -वी|{%f.%}) [ऋतुरस्य प्राप्तः, अण्] .²1 Conforming or relating to the season; seasonal; अभिभूय विभूतिमार्तवीम् <ls>R. 8. 36</ls>, स्वयमङ्गेषु ममेदमार्तवम् <ls>Ku. 4. 68</ls>; लताभिः श्रीरिवार्तवी <ls>V. 1. 13</ls>; vernal; <ls>R. 9. 28</ls>, <ls n="R. 9.">48</ls>. .²2 Menstrual, relating to or produced by this discharge. .{@-वः@} A section of the year, a combination of several seasons (<ab>Ved.</ab>). .{@-वी@} A mare. .{@-वम्@} The menstrual discharge (of women), नोपगच्छेत्प्रमत्तोऽपि स्त्रियमार्तवदर्शने <ls>Ms. 4. 40</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">3. 48</ls>. .²2 Certain days after menstrual discharge, favourable to conception. .²3 Menstrual ablution; गिरिकायाः प्रयच्छाशु तस्या ह्यार्तवमद्य वै <ls>Mb. 1. 63. 55</ls>. .²4 A flower.
